findings.failure_mode: Unreadable, missing, or permission-denied paths panic the entire program instead of returning a typed I/O error
findings.fix: Return Result<Vec<Record>, IoError> and propagate fs::read_to_string errors with ? or explicit Err

findings.problem: parts[1].parse::<u32>().unwrap() — production unwrap on untrusted parse
findings.failure_mode: Malformed CSV with a non-numeric second field panics instead of returning a typed parse error
findings.fix: Use .parse::<u32>().map_err(|e| ParseError::InvalidValue(e)) or similar typed domain error, never unwrap

findings.problem: lossy as u16 cast on a u32 value with no range check
findings.failure_mode: Any u32 > 65535 silently truncates to u16, corrupting the stored value with no error or warning
findings.fix: Use u16::try_from(parts[1]) or .try_into() with map_err to return a typed OverflowError for out-of-range values

findings.problem: line.split(',').map(...).collect() followed by unchecked indexing parts[0] and parts[1]
findings.failure_mode: Empty lines, lines with fewer than 2 comma-separated fields, or lines with extra fields all silently produce incorrect records or panic on parts[1]
findings.fix: Use line.split_once(',') for first-delimiter extraction, then get or split again on the remainder; check parts.len() >= 2 or use split_once twice

findings.problem: println!("loaded {}", parts[0]) — logging/side-effect inside a pure-purported data loader
findings.failure_mode: Side effects in a data-loading function make the core impure, break determinism, and contaminate test output; violates functional-core imperative-shell boundary
findings.fix: Remove println entirely from the core; push I/O/logging to the shell layer and return an opaque result

findings.problem: load_sessions returns Vec<Record> with no try_reserve or bounded capacity handling
findings.failure_mode: Unbounded file input can OOM the process; allocation failure is never observed or handled
findings.fix: Use try_reserve (with checked_add/checked_mul for capacity estimate) or cap the line count and handle AllocationError

findings.problem: load_sessions couples I/O (fs::read_to_string) with pure parsing logic in a single function
findings.failure_mode: Cannot unit-test parsing without filesystem access; violates functional-core/imperative-shell separation
findings.fix: Split into a shell function (read file, call parser) and a pure core function (parse &[str] -> Vec<Record>)

findings.problem: parts[0] and parts[1] — unchecked indexing on Vec<String>
findings.failure_mode: A line with zero or one comma-separated fields will panic with index-out-of-bounds
findings.fix: Use parts.get(0) and parts.get(1) or split_once to ensure safe access
